summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated 728KB Bun payload
details: Package advertised as a Babel preset (index.js is a ~15-line wrapper around @babel/preset-react) ships a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifiers (_0x... names, per-function string dictionaries) and, at npm install time, downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (pinned v1.3.13), extracts and chmod +x's it, then invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~728KB single-line, heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (begins `// @bun @bun-cjs`, followed by a shuffling dispatcher `WV8StW` that rotates a large mixed numeric/string constant array). A Babel preset has no functional need for a second language runtime or a 728KB opaque payload; the runtime is fetched specifically so the payload executes under an interpreter that node-based inspection does not parse. Package is published under the @ornikar scope and points at ornikar/shared-configs, but the install behavior is inconsistent with the stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
